page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head centred at top with page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: II. Quia observatis nervis ἀληθείας[?], non sit difficilis.
I. Vt ex consensu doctrinae apostolicae authoritas confirmetur.
II. ut vitentur praepostera judicia de libris sacris.
III. Vt doctrina Iustificationis fidei contra Sophistas defendatur ac illustretur.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XIII.

p.i: Scribatur Narratio instaurationis Templi & cultus post reditum populi ex Babylone: observatis bona narrationis legibus: & expressa praecipue temporis notatione: ex Esdrae cap. 1. 3. 4. 5. 6.

main_text.p: MEmbra praecipua haec sint, quae non numerentur, sed aptè contexantur: & vitetur prolixitas.
I. Tempus, & causae efficientes atq; adjuvantes reditus: cap. 1.
II. Prima cultus instauratio: Vbi de altaris structura: primis sacrificiis, & templi fundamentis jactis, anno secundo reditus populi & monarchiae Cyri: cap. 3.

III. Impedimenta structurae Templi: ubi breviter exponantur calumniae Toparcharum ad Consiliarios Cyri absentis in Massagetis, h. e, ad proregem Cambysen. c. 4. v. 5. & ad Ahasverum Darium Histaspis contra aedificantes: ibid. ver. 6.

page.notes: Greek word in item II of the first paragraph is worn; the reading ἀληθείας is uncertain. A small mark at the left of the last line ("H v:") is unclear and was copied only as "v:". The printed woodcut-style initial M of "Membra" is joined to "Embra" as printed. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
